message: refactor(crafting): paginate equipment recipes and pin validated crafting actions
purpose: Keep large equipment catalogs usable. Preserve native controls during selection and snapshots, show exact ingredient/skill/station errors, remove unused leather supplies, preserve legacy NPC art, and render equipment grades in the actual client.
